Senses.Explanation: To respond or provide according to the abundance or frugality of each household—an image for adapting teaching, hospitality, or conduct to available capacity. Jingming Fayin answers a question about which of Zhaozhou’s three levels he uses by saying that it follows each household’s means. Zhe'an Jingfan puts mixed rice and stew beside the formula, presenting unpretentious provision without anxiety. Boshan Lai says Dasui and Longji guide beings according to each household’s abundance or frugality. Xishan Yin says two earlier replies differ because each household supplies according to its means. Linquan Conglun’s verse says household plenty and frugality are originally equal, although dress and dwelling vary. Letan Hongying answers a challenge about honoring Huanglong with the household-means formula.
